propositions: Documentation surfaces (overview.txt, ticket-model.md) claim unlink accepts no relation argument, contradicting the relation-scoped optional parameter shipped in commit 73abb5805f and present in rebar.unlink library and rebar unlink CLI
The event-schema.md operation wording for unlink does not distinguish between optional operation-level relation selection and the emitted link_uuid-targeted UNLINK event cancellation

Commit 73abb5805f updated subcommand help and generated references but omitted independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md, creating published contract contradiction verified by live CLI subprocess observation
Omitted relation selector must fall back to most-recent active relation per pair, while explicit canonical relation removes exactly that relation and preserves other active relations on the pair
